get.description: Retrieve a list of event definitions available in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to search and filter event definitions based on various criteria, such as search strings and pagination options. It is useful for managing and understanding the different event types that are tracked within your account.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: A cursor token for pagination. Use the value from the previous response's paging.next.after field to retrieve the next set of results.

parameters.name: includeProperties
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to include event properties in the response.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return per page.

parameters.name: searchString
parameters.description: A string to filter event definitions by name or description.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: The order in which to sort the results. Accepts values like 'asc' or 'desc'.

post.description: Create a new behavioral event definition in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to define the structure and properties of a new behavioral event, which can then be used to track specific user actions or behaviors. The request body must include the necessary event details and property definitions.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

get.description: Retrieve the definition of a specific behavioral event in your HubSpot account by providing the event name. This endpoint returns detailed information about the event type, including its properties and associations.

parameters.name: eventName
parameters.description: The unique name of the event definition to retrieve.

delete.description: Delete a specific event definition in your HubSpot account using the event's unique name. This operation is useful for removing outdated or incorrect event definitions that are no longer needed.

parameters.name: eventName
parameters.description: The unique name of the event definition to delete.

patch.description: Update the definition of a specific behavioral event in your HubSpot account. This operation allows you to modify the properties and templates associated with the event. The eventName path parameter identifies the event to be updated.

parameters.name: eventName
parameters.description: The unique name of the event definition to update.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Create a new property for a specified event definition in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to define custom properties associated with a particular event, enhancing the tracking and analysis of behavioral events. The request must include a JSON body with the necessary property details.

parameters.name: eventName
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the event definition for which the property is being created.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

delete.description: Delete a specific property from an event definition in your HubSpot account. This operation is useful when you need to remove obsolete or incorrect properties from an event definition. Ensure that the event and property names are accurately specified to avoid unintended deletions.

parameters.name: eventName
parameters.description: The unique name of the event definition from which the property will be deleted.

parameters.name: propertyName
parameters.description: The unique name of the property to be deleted from the event definition.

patch.description: Update a specific property of a behavioral event definition in your HubSpot account. This operation allows you to modify the details of an existing property associated with a given event. Use this endpoint to keep your event properties up-to-date with the latest information.

parameters.name: eventName
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the event whose property you want to update.

parameters.name: propertyName
parameters.description: The name of the property to be updated within the specified event.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Send a batch of behavioral events to the HubSpot API. This endpoint is useful for efficiently processing multiple events in a single request, reducing the number of API calls needed. It is particularly beneficial for applications that need to send a high volume of events quickly. Note that this endpoint is exempt from daily and ten-secondly rate limits.
